11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A child who wants to be the bravest in the village finds a large beetle beside the sleeping mat.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has decided to become the bravest person in the village. Unfortunately, this morning a particularly large beetle has appeared beside (subject.his/her) sleeping mat. The beetle is doing nothing threatening. It is simply being a beetle. (subject) watches it from a safe distance.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (friend) gently carries the beetle outside. "I thought you wanted to be brave," (friend.he/she) says. "I do," replies (subject). "But I think I'll start with smaller beetles."

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) approaches carefully. The beetle moves one leg. (subject) retreats. After several attempts, (subject.he/she) manages to examine it from a comfortable distance. By afternoon (subject) has drawn a remarkably accurate picture of the creature. (subject.He/She) still doesn't want it near the sleeping mat.
